Dialight is hiring a Software Developer, Salesforce to optimize, configure, enhance, and maintain Salesforce. The role focuses on improving user experience, designing scalable solutions and interfaces, maintaining data integrity, training users, and creating reports and dashboards.
Electronics

Lighting

Responsibilities
Optimize, configure, enhance and maintain Salesforce, improving functionality and user experience
Identify opportunities for improvement within Salesforce, recommend best practices, and implement scalable solutions
Lead the design of user interfaces and experiences to streamline processes and drive adoption across various departments
Configure objects, fields, record types, workflows, process builders, and validation rules
Ensure data integrity and cleanliness
Provide training and create user-friendly documentation for team members to ensure high adoption of Salesforce processes and features
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics to help teams make informed decisions
